prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1007; do not mention it.)
text: I was driving in the right lane on a busy road in Baytown, Texas, when I signaled and began moving left to change lanes. As I merged, a vehicle in the left lane came up alongside me and its side struck the passenger side of my car, pushing me toward the median. I checked my mirror and saw the other driver had not been looking, and I was unable to avoid contact. Both cars sustained visible damage along the side panels. I pulled onto the shoulder and stayed in my vehicle until emergency responders arrived. I felt a sharp pain in my left wrist after bracing against the steering wheel. Later I was told the wrist was fractured, and I have been wearing a splint and attending follow-up appointments since the incident.
